seo.description: TablePro is free to download and use. Pro and Team plans add optional features. Prices in US dollars.

og.title: Free to use. Paid plans add optional features.
og.teamPrice: {price} per seat, per month, billed yearly

header.title: Pricing
header.lead: TablePro is free, at work too. Pro and Team add features.

features.title: What a paid plan adds
features.lead: Only these need a paid plan. Everything else is free.

faq.title: Questions
faq.more: More questions about plans and licenses

macs.question: How many computers does a license cover?
macs.answer: Pro covers one person on up to {deviceLimit} computers, Mac or Linux, and so does each Team seat. Free one up in <account>your account</account> or in <ui>Settings > Account</ui> on the Mac.

offline.question: Does TablePro need to be online?
offline.answer: It renews your plan daily and keeps paid features working offline for up to {offlineDays} days. A Mac that is never online uses an offline file from <account>your account</account>.

ends.question: What happens when a plan ends?
ends.answer: Paid features stop, each in its own way, and everything in Free keeps working. A one-time license has no expiry date. See the <terms>terms of service</terms>.

lost-key.question: Where is my license key?
lost-key.answer: You no longer need one: sign in with your purchase email. Versions before TablePro accounts take the key from that email and work {graceDays} days offline.

payment-methods.question: How can I pay?
payment-methods.answer: By card. {merchant}, the merchant of record, adds sales tax or VAT and emails receipts.

company-invoice.question: Can I get an invoice for my company?
company-invoice.answer: Yes. Add a company name, VAT number and address in <portal>{merchant}’s customer portal</portal>, then download it.

renewals.question: How do renewals work?
renewals.answer: Subscriptions renew until you cancel in <account>your account</account>, and access lasts to the end of the paid period. {merchant} retries a failed payment for about three weeks.

refunds.question: Can I get a refund?
refunds.answer: Yes, within {refundDays} days of a purchase or a renewal, from Billing in <account>your account</account>. See the <link>refund policy</link>.

seats.question: How do Team seats work?
seats.answer: From {min} seats. Owners and admins invite people; the owner changes seats in Billing, and {merchant} prorates the difference. <teams>TablePro for teams</teams>

at-work.question: Can I use the free app at work?
at-work.answer: Yes, in a company of any size, and nothing free today will become paid. If TablePro is part of your work, a license pays for the next release.

education.question: Do students and teachers get Pro?
education.answer: Yes, free for a year with a school or university email: choose <ui>Get Pro free</ui> in <account>your account</account>. It is Pro for one person, not for an account that already paid for Pro. Address not recognized? Write to <email>{email}</email>.

open-source.question: Is TablePro open source?
open-source.answer: Yes, under the AGPLv3, paid features included. The AGPL sets no conditions on running it. <github>View on GitHub</github>
